scope: Descriptive provenance for the unchanged packaged TXS 0506+056 photon snapshot; not a new reduction, statistical calibration, or source-model calculation.

frozen_raw.meaning: Serialized SSDC snapshot, not original HTTP response bytes.

row_identity.indexing: One-based data-row index, excluding the CSV header; row order is preserved.
row_identity.join_rule: measurement_groups partition all 780 rows. ssdc_dataset_mapping is an overlapping source cross-reference for the 729 SSDC rows, not additional measurements. A source_key alone is not a unique row identifier.

precedence.descriptive: Verified timing corrections and uncertainty qualifications in this file supersede the corresponding descriptive statements in the historical CSV/PROVENANCE.md.
precedence.numerical: This file is not consumed by the canonical loader and does not override CSV values, roles, errors, or numerical inputs. Numerical reproduction uses the identified packaged CSV.
precedence.regeneration: Original historical HTTP bytes/headers and parts of the extraction record are unavailable. Current archive re-downloads can differ; the packaged snapshot and regeneration from today's service are distinct reproducibility claims.

runtime_treatment.selection: The helper preserves CSV row order. The notebook removes role=exclude before SEDDataset; the likelihood selects roles fit and constraint. The local diagnostic selects role=fit and statistic_type=gaussian (48 rows). Dates do not reselect runtime rows.
runtime_treatment.upstream_dates: The historical extractor selects NuSTAR using SSDC dataset 14923 plus the exact stored start/stop, and selects the XRT fit point by MJD 58023.8535. Other XRT dates determine descriptive epoch labels. Published H.E.S.S./VERITAS roles are literal campaign constraints, not selected by their stored date strings.
runtime_treatment.order_and_identity: The historical extractor sorts by frequency_hz and instrument; no deduplication is implemented. The canonical loader and dataset retain order. Instrument names affect plotting groups and undergo nonempty validation. Source locators/keys are provenance, not numerical weights.
runtime_treatment.symmetric_detection: For an active gaussian row, the stored positive flux error is treated as a Gaussian scale and mapped to sigma_log = sigma_F/F. This first-order symmetric log-Gaussian approximation also sets the local diagnostic weights W=diag(1/sigma_log^2). It is not verification of a source's confidence convention or inter-bin independence.
runtime_treatment.asymmetric_detection: The active XRT row uses the stored lower/upper errors to form log(F)-log(F-error_lower) and log(F+error_upper)-log(F). The existing continuous split-normal log-flux likelihood uses the side selected by the sign of log(model/F). It is excluded from the symmetric local diagnostic.
runtime_treatment.upper_limit: The ten active 95% limits use the adopted null-centered one-sided Gaussian surrogate with sigma_eff=U/Phi^-1(0.95) and -log Phi((U-model)/sigma_eff). Stored zero error columns flag limits; they are not zero-uncertainty detections. This is not the instrument's count likelihood. Context limits are not assigned 95% confidence by this convention.
runtime_treatment.energy_bounds: The model is sampled at central energy by log-log interpolation; horizontal errors do not perform bin integration or energy-response convolution and do not enter likelihood/diagnostic weights. They must be finite and nonnegative and the lower error must be smaller than central energy for dataset validation. The example helper displays active horizontal errors; the adopted paper Figure 5 omits horizontal error bars.
runtime_treatment.plotting: Instrument/role/statistic labels control styles and active/context rendering. Vertical active errors are the stored flux errors. Upper-limit arrow stems are graphical lengths, not uncertainties. Context points are displayed without likelihood weight.
runtime_treatment.interpretation: Campaign-centered, not strictly simultaneous. Neither the stored roles nor the accompanying documentation assert a uniform statistical error convention across instruments.

nublazar_sed.locator: Section 3; Figure 3; Section 4.1/Figure 10; official product column help and TXS SED ASCII header; SSDC dataset 14923
nublazar_sed.measurement: 44 NuBlazar spectral points for observation 90301618002, acquired through SSDC dataset 14923. Middei's pipeline constructs SEDs using the fitted spectrum and corrects Galactic absorption.
nublazar_sed.reported_error: SSDC NufnuError, copied as equal positive lower/upper flux errors. The product SED header labels flux error but supplies no confidence definition.
nublazar_sed.distinction: Official catalogue help labels fitted spectral-parameter and integrated-flux errors at 90%; Figure 10 describes integrated-light-curve errors at 68%. Neither establishes the convention for these individual SED bins.
nublazar_sed.adopted: No confidence conversion; stored errors are used directly in symmetric_detection and in all 44 associated local-diagnostic weights.
nublazar_sed.energy_field: SSDC FrequencyError is converted with h and stored symmetrically. It is the archive horizontal error/width field, not a verified Gaussian energy-calibration uncertainty.
nublazar_sed.decision: Confirm the bin-error definition or explicitly approve the adopted diagonal scales and their limitations before data finalization. Do not divide all bins by a generic 90%-to-one-sigma factor.

xrt_pivot.measurement: 0.3-10 keV power-law flux and photon index, converted to a 1 keV nu F_nu pivot.
xrt_pivot.interval_convention: Published lower/upper parameter intervals; a joint flux-index contour and its relevant parameter count are not supplied for this conversion.
xrt_pivot.transformation: P(F,Gamma)=F*(2-Gamma)/(10^(2-Gamma)-0.3^(2-Gamma)) at 1 keV, with logarithmic limit F/ln(10/0.3) at Gamma=2. The extractor takes extrema over the four endpoint combinations of band flux and index, then divides the pivot offsets by Phi^-1(0.95)=1.6448536269514722.
xrt_pivot.adopted: Asymmetric scales enter asymmetric_detection; no XRT row enters the 48-row local diagnostic.
xrt_pivot.assessment: The published 90% statement and saved arithmetic are verified. A rectangle of marginal endpoints is not a measured joint 90% contour; dividing its nonlinear envelope by a normal quantile does not statistically calibrate the pivot errors.
xrt_pivot.decision: Author acceptance of this approximation, or a separately authorized covariance/joint-spectrum-based correction and bounded impact check. No evidence in this check establishes a uniquely correct replacement.

uvot_pivot.locator: Section 2.6, Table 4, MJD 58023.8470; distinguish Table 2 and the plotted SED bands
uvot_pivot.measurement: Extinction-corrected nu F_nu at 1e15 Hz: (34.80 +/- 3.13)e-12 erg cm^-2 s^-1.
uvot_pivot.reported_error: Section 2.6 uses six-filter SED fits with flux, slope, and extinction; for single-filter estimates it combines counting and adopted SED-model uncertainty in quadrature. Table 4 does not separately specify the confidence definition of its quoted flux error.
uvot_pivot.statistical_systematic_split: Extinction-model uncertainty is included in the SED analysis; no separable per-point statistical/systematic columns are supplied.
uvot_pivot.distinction: Table 2 magnitude errors are explicitly one sigma; sampled SED bands encompass 90%. Neither statement is automatically the convention of the adopted Table 4 flux error. The paper does not add the estimated 12% Epoch-1 variability broadening.
uvot_pivot.adopted: 3.13e-12 is copied without rescaling into symmetric_detection and the local diagnostic.
uvot_pivot.decision: Confirm the Table 4 flux-error definition or explicitly approve the adopted scale with this qualification.

lat_pivot.reported_error: Quoted normalization error from the broadband binned-likelihood power-law fit; no confidence definition for this particular scalar is given in the paragraph.
lat_pivot.distinction: The later 90% statement refers to separately refitted SED energy bins (or 95% limits), not explicitly to K at the pivot.
lat_pivot.transformation: nu F_nu = (1440 MeV)^2 K * 1.602176634e-6 erg/MeV; propagate the quoted K error by the same factor. Index and normalization covariance are not reconstructed.
lat_pivot.adopted: Stored flux 4.71762832493e-11 and error 3.65450081509e-12 enter symmetric_detection and the local diagnostic.
lat_pivot.decision: Confirm the scalar normalization-error convention or explicitly approve the adopted scale.

agile_pivot.locator: Supplement AGILE subsection, page S23 (PDF page 49)
agile_pivot.measurement: 13-day window centered at MJD 58012.5: flux above 100 MeV (5.3 +/- 2.1)e-7 cm^-2 s^-1; reported 200 MeV energy-flux density (8.8 +/- 3.5)e-11 erg cm^-2 s^-1 for index -2.
agile_pivot.reported_error: Error from the specific campaign ML measurement; confidence and statistical/systematic split are not specified there.
agile_pivot.distinction: ATel 10801 is a different preliminary three-day measurement and does not establish this 13-day flux-error convention.
agile_pivot.adopted: The published 200 MeV value and error are copied directly into symmetric_detection and the local diagnostic, not rederived from rounded integral-flux scalars.
agile_pivot.decision: Confirm this measurement's error definition or explicitly approve the adopted scale. The relatively large fractional error also limits the first-order log-Gaussian approximation.

magic_pivot.locator: Main text VHE spectrum, PDF page 8; MAGIC supplement
magic_pivot.measurement: Observed normalization K=(2.0 +/- 0.4)e-10 TeV^-1 cm^-2 s^-1 at E0=0.130 TeV.
magic_pivot.reported_error: The quoted normalization error is statistical only. The paper separately gives 11-18% normalization systematic uncertainty and an energy-scale systematic smaller than 15%.
magic_pivot.interval_convention: A numerical confidence level for the normalization error and a Gaussian interpretation of the systematic range are not explicitly specified by the cited passage.
magic_pivot.statistical_systematic_split: Statistical K error 0.4e-10; adopted systematic contribution 0.18*K, using the upper end of the reported range.
magic_pivot.transformation: F=E0^2*K*1.602176634; adopted sigma_F=E0^2*sqrt((0.4e-10)^2+(0.18*K)^2)*1.602176634. Stored horizontal error=0.15*130 GeV=19.5 GeV.
magic_pivot.adopted: The quadrature flux scale enters symmetric_detection and the local diagnostic. The 15% horizontal value is used for validation/display, not energy convolution, sampling, or weights.
magic_pivot.assessment: The algebra reproduces the stored values. Combining the upper-end systematic with the statistical term as a per-point Gaussian scale is an adopted approximation, not a published combined error. The 15% energy entry is a conservative descriptive choice, not an exact published Gaussian sigma or an energy-bin width.
magic_pivot.decision: Author acceptance of the flux-systematic treatment and unresolved normalization-error confidence; if changed, separately authorize an active-weight/diagnostic impact check.

VERITAS.source_interval_convention: One-sided differential flux upper limits; assumed E^-3.9 spectrum.
VERITAS.source_statistical_systematic: Rolke-Lopez construction is described; energy-scale systematic 15-20% is reported separately. This documentation does not assert it was folded into each limit.
VERITAS.treatment: Geometric bin energy sqrt(E_min*E_max); E^2 dN/dE with 1 TeV=1.602176634 erg. The larger distance from geometric center to the two bin edges is stored symmetrically as the horizontal width; it is not a calibration uncertainty or a faithful pair of exact bin edges.

H.E.S.S..treatment: Geometric bin energy sqrt(E_min*E_max); E^2 dN/dE with 1 TeV=1.602176634 erg. The larger center-to-edge distance is stored symmetrically as the horizontal width, not as a calibration uncertainty.

hess.correction: The six Table S5 limits combine the full follow-up data set, including the later nights; they are not restricted to MJD 58019-58020.
hess.time_precision: Table S4 gives rounded nightly MJDs to 0.01 day and observation times, but not exact boundaries. Representative epochs are not promoted to exact midpoints/start/stop.
hess.exposure_qualification: The body text's 3.25 h and Table S4 sum of 3.48 h are distinct reported quantities with an unexplained mismatch; do not derive boundaries or replace one by the other.
hess.selection_effect: None in the adopted workflow: these rows' roles were literal constraints upstream and no date filtering occurs downstream. The corrected observation set remains within the nominal MJD 58003-58033 campaign window.

veritas.correction: Table S7 uses post-alert observations within two weeks. Select the four post-alert Table S6 windows, not its three historical entries.
veritas.time_precision: Start/stop values are arithmetic center +/- half-width at Table S6's 0.0001-day printed precision, not new precision from raw event times.
veritas.enclosing_interval_meaning: Envelope of the four tabulated windows, including gaps; not uninterrupted exposure.
veritas.exposure_qualification: The summed windows and quality-selected exposure are different quantities; no equality is assumed.
veritas.selection_effect: None in the adopted workflow; roles were literal constraints. All four windows remain within MJD 58003-58033.
